requirement: Operators must complete a pre-start check of each item of mobile plant before use each shift.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: mobile plant must be checked before use each shift.
evidence_example: Signed pre-start checklist for each machine each shift

requirement: Defects found at pre-start must be reported and unsafe plant taken out of service until repaired.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: unsafe plant must be taken out of service.
evidence_example: Defect report with close-out and an out-of-service tag

requirement: Pre-start checks should cover brakes, steering, seat belt, reversing alarm and fire suppression.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: checks should cover critical safety features.
evidence_example: Checklist with brakes and steering items ticked and signed

requirement: Only competent and authorised operators may operate mobile plant.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: operators must be competent.
evidence_example: Competency record for the operator named on the pre-start

requirement: Conveyor nip points and tail pulleys must be guarded and the guards inspected regularly.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: nip points must be guarded.
evidence_example: Guard inspection record for CV-01 with date and inspector

requirement: Plant must be isolated and locked out before cleaning, maintenance or clearing blockages.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: plant must be isolated before cleaning.
evidence_example: Isolation register entry and personal lock on the isolator

requirement: Emergency stops and pull-wire switches must be tested at set intervals.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: emergency stops must be tested.
evidence_example: Pull-wire test log for each conveyor

requirement: Contractors must complete a site induction before starting work.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: contractors must be inducted.
evidence_example: Signed induction record for each contractor

requirement: The quarry must check contractors' competency, licences and insurance before work starts.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: contractor competency must be checked.
evidence_example: Prequalification file with licences and insurance

requirement: Contractors must provide a safe work method statement for high-risk work.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: SWMS must be provided.
evidence_example: SWMS reviewed and signed before the job

requirement: Contractor work must be supervised and coordinated with quarry activities.
quote: TEST FIXTURE: contractor work must be supervised.
evidence_example: Supervisor sign-off on the job card
